title: Infinitesimal automorphisms and obstruction theory on the moduli of $L$-valued $G$-Higgs bundles
summary: For an arbitrary reductive group $G$, we compute the infinitesimal automorphisms of $L$-valued principal $G$-Higgs bundles over a compact Kähler manifold $X$, extending known results for $Ω_X^{1}$-valued $G$-Higgs bundles. Using this computation, when $G$ is semisimple and $X$ is a smooth projective variety, we show that the moduli stack of stable $L$-valued $G$-Higgs bundles is a Deligne-Mumford (DM) stack.
